protocolNotes.summary: Median of 5 process medians per version; paired ratio range is the observed range, not a confidence interval. Reference tools: 3 process medians, unchanged previously built artifacts, measured after version pairs.
protocolNotes.power: All measurements in this snapshot use AC power. Previous reports used battery with lowpowermode=1; their times are not the version baseline.
protocolNotes.compiler: Default release commands; optimizer/sanitizer settings not normalized across tools. compileMs includes diagnostic C/IR generation and is not a compile-time benchmark.
protocolNotes.semantics: All retained workloads have matching checksums. scriptc JS object workloads excluded by shared-reference probe, both versions output 0 instead of 9. Finite probes do not establish full language conformance.
protocolNotes.limits: Date.now 1ms batch resolution except hrtime hello. Serial execution on an interactive Apple M1 host; no temperature/frequency control or hardware profiling. Measurements are specific to these inputs and native macOS arm64.

scriptcJson.counts: Static call sites in benchmarkWorkload, including cleanup branches; not dynamic allocation or invocation counts.
